concept: stick person picking up a gift box
layout_notes: person stands at left-center, box rests on the ground slightly ahead of the feet; the bend reaches down and right, the lift rises back to the same standing spot; all action stays in the middle of the frame

parts.name: person_torso
parts.notes: bends forward at the hips on grasp

parts.name: person_leg_left
parts.notes: slight knee bend on grasp, feet stay near same spot

parts.name: person_leg_right
parts.notes: slight knee bend on grasp, feet stay near same spot

parts.name: gift_box
parts.how: small square of two short lines
parts.notes: on the ground until grasp, then parents to the hands and rises with the body

parts.name: ground
parts.how: single horizontal line across the frame
parts.notes: exact same points and t_values on every key

keys.name: start
keys.body: stand upright, arms hanging at sides, hands empty
keys.box: on the ground ahead of the feet

keys.name: grasp
keys.body: bent over at the hips, knees slightly bent, both hands down on the box
keys.box: in both hands, still resting on the ground
keys.notes: contact key: hands touch the box; box does not move yet

keys.name: end
keys.body: upright again, box hugged to the torso with both arms
keys.notes: lift complete, box parents to the hands through the rise
